Specifications.Display: 15.6” with 1920 x 1080 resolution. Use in landscape or portrait orientation.
Specifications.Wifi Connectivity: Wifi 6E (802.1ax) is supported. Tri-band, dual-antenna wifi (MIMO). Supports 802.11a/b/g/n/ac wifi networks. Does not support connecting to ad-hoc (or IBSS) wifi networks.
Specifications.System requirements: Echo Show 15 comes ready to connect to your wifi. The Alexa app is compatible with Fire OS, Android, and iOS devices and also accessible via your web browser. Learn more about Certain skills and services may require subscription or other fees.
Specifications.Set up requirements: Amazon wifi simple setup enables customers to connect smart devices to their wifi network in a few easy steps. Wifi simple setup is another way Alexa is always getting smarter.
Specifications.Processor: Octa-core SoC with Amazon AZ2 neural network engine
Specifications.Included in the Box: Echo Show 15 2nd Gen, Alexa Voice Remote (2024) with batteries, power adapter (30W) and 5 ft. cord (white), wall mount, anchors, screws, mounting template, and quick start guide. Setup requires wifi. Device can be wall mounted (electric drill required) or placed on a stand (sold separately).
